name: Title sequence — signal
description: Depth-stage deliverable for the title-sequence family (ADR-0028). The heavy condensed title rides the near plane over a real photographic backdrop (atmosphere-warm substrate) at depth; a bold dolly-in drives true parallax between type and photo while the rack focus starts fully on the backdrop and lands on the title as its per-character rise completes — the title arrives INTO focus. The photo takes a centre darken for type contrast, the Pack key light rakes the scene, and the glyphs throw soft real shadows onto the photo. The flat title-sequence-drop keeps the shader motion-blur drop; this piece is the same family restaged with a real camera. [Re-grounded 2026-07-09: depth stage + photographic atmosphere removed — the lens grammar is not the Syntax brand (same ruling as type-hero-vantage); flat warm-black field.]
